description: Videos from youtube.com/hashtag/{name} — nested channel{}, viewCountIsApproximate. Not keyword search. Costs ~20 credits (1/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Returns a single window; use limit to size it. No cursor. Billed per result.

q.description: Hashtag with or without the # (min 2 characters).

name: youtube_hashtag_search
title: YouTube Hashtag Search
